policy_review.distinct_customer_policy: pass — convex/lib/filePolicy.ts models customer as a distinct access level while genericAccessLevelValidator deliberately excludes it; schema and generated types accept the dedicated value
policy_review.exact_customer_binding: pass — listMyCustomerDocuments and getCustomerAuthorizedBlob require canonical tokenIdentifier authentication, an active exact CUSTOMER_ROLES membership in the document organization, and a unique customers.by_org_and_user binding
policy_review.resource_scope: pass — customer reads require accessLevel=customer, a present jobId, a job in the same organization, and job.customerId equal to the exact bound customer record
policy_review.generic_api_isolation: pass — generic getDocument/getAuthorizedBlob/getDownloadUrl reject customer documents; generic listDocuments cannot accept the customer value; public metadata omits blobUrl and blobPathname
policy_review.creation_scope: pass — customer-grant uploads require an active operations membership, same-organization job, and same-organization customer; crew roles are denied even when assigned; uploadedBy is derived from the authenticated actor
policy_review.private_blob_boundary: pass — no ctx.storage path exists; uploads are private Vercel Blob presigns, finalizeUpload validates authoritative head content type/size/path, and customer downloads are five-minute get-only private presigns produced only after the specialized authorization query
policy_review.pagination: pass — customer listing uses the organization/access index plus Convex pagination, rejects unsafe numItems values, caps each page at 50, and revalidates every page row against its job/customer relationship
policy_review.portal_workflow: pass — CustomerDashboard conditionally mounts the exact customer query, uses the specialized paginated list and download action, and renders first-load, empty, load-more/loading-more, per-file authorization progress, and recoverable download-error states

residual_risks.summary: The specialized list paginates organization-wide customer documents and then filters each bounded page by job/customer ownership.
residual_risks.impact: No unauthorized record or Blob coordinate is returned, but a customer with sparse documents may need multiple Load More requests and can infer coarse organization-wide document-density state from pagination completion behavior.
residual_risks.recommendation: If document volume becomes material, denormalize the authorized customerId onto customer-visible document metadata and add an organization/customer index, with a migration that revalidates each job/customer link.

residual_risks.summary: The private Blob and protected customer portal flows were verified statically, in unit/integration tests, and in a production compile, but not against an isolated live Preview deployment.
residual_risks.impact: Environment provisioning, Blob-store permissions, WorkOS claims, or Preview protection could still fail operationally without weakening the reviewed server-side policy.
residual_risks.recommendation: After this SHA is pushed, run exact-SHA anonymous, wrong-customer, revoked-membership, private-upload/head/finalize/download, and CustomerDashboard browser smokes in isolated Preview infrastructure before merge.

test_coverage_notes: The hostile Convex suite directly covers anonymous, wrong-organization, other-customer, cross-organization job, unbound job, internal/restricted substitution, crew creation, exact customer grant, generic API bypass, Blob-coordinate redaction, and oversized pagination cases.

CustomerDashboard is wired to real Convex hooks, but its loading/load-more/download/error rendering is presently supported by source-contract and compile coverage rather than a behavioral DOM interaction test; adding that test would improve regression precision without blocking this verdict.

Active membership and suspended-organization fail-closed behavior are centralized in requireActiveMembership and covered elsewhere in the 178-test regression suite; a customer-document-specific revoked-membership case would make the local threat proof more explicit.
release_gates: Push the immutable candidate and require exact-SHA CI, Security, and Vercel Preview results; checks on another revision do not count.
Use isolated Preview WorkOS, Convex, and Vercel Blob credentials and seed at least two organizations and two customers for hostile browser/API smokes.
Do not merge dev to main, deploy Production, attach a Production domain, mutate Production Convex or Blob data, send customer communications, or change DNS without the required human approval.
verdict_rationale: Pass. At 106175ce6a1af7e6fa925cc7fa38a3cf76a857bd, customer documents have a distinct policy, exact active membership and customer-record binding, same-organization job/customer enforcement, generic API isolation, server-derived uploader identity, operations-scoped creation, crew denial, private Vercel Blob-only signed access, bounded pagination, and a real CustomerDashboard list/download workflow. Focused hostile tests, the 178-test suite, typecheck, lint, environment/asset/skill gates, dependency audit, exact-commit hygiene, and the production build are all green. The two documented residual risks are nonblocking and do not expose customer records or Blob coordinates.
